probes.name: field
probes.macro:
Public Type Inner
V() As Long
End Type
Public Type Outer
B() As Long
I As Inner
S() As String
End Type
Dim B As Long
Function Probe() As String
Dim r As Outer
ReDim r.B(0 To 9)
r.B(9) = 7
Probe = LBound(r.B) & "|" & UBound(r.B) & "|" & r.B(9) & "|" & B
End Function

probes.name: nested
probes.macro:
Public Type Inner
V() As Long
End Type
Public Type Outer
B() As Long
I As Inner
S() As String
End Type
Dim B As Long
Function Probe() As String
Dim r As Outer
ReDim r.I.V(2 To 4)
r.I.V(4) = 3
Probe = LBound(r.I.V) & "|" & UBound(r.I.V) & "|" & r.I.V(4)
End Function

probes.name: preserve
probes.macro:
Public Type Inner
V() As Long
End Type
Public Type Outer
B() As Long
I As Inner
S() As String
End Type
Dim B As Long
Function Probe() As String
Dim r As Outer
ReDim r.B(0 To 1)
r.B(1) = 5
ReDim Preserve r.B(0 To 3)
Probe = UBound(r.B) & "|" & r.B(1)
End Function

probes.name: with
probes.macro:
Public Type Inner
V() As Long
End Type
Public Type Outer
B() As Long
I As Inner
S() As String
End Type
Dim B As Long
Function Probe() As String
Dim r As Outer
With r
ReDim .S(1)
.S(1) = "x"
End With
Probe = UBound(r.S) & "|" & r.S(1)
End Function

probes.name: two
probes.macro:
Public Type Inner
V() As Long
End Type
Public Type Outer
B() As Long
I As Inner
S() As String
End Type
Dim B As Long
Function Probe() As String
Dim r As Outer
ReDim r.B(1), r.S(2)
Probe = UBound(r.B) & "|" & UBound(r.S) & "|" & TypeName(r.S)
End Function

probes.name: array_element
probes.macro:
Public Type Inner
V() As Long
End Type
Public Type Outer
B() As Long
I As Inner
S() As String
End Type
Dim B As Long
Function Probe() As String
Dim a(1) As Outer
ReDim a(1).B(0 To 4)
Probe = UBound(a(1).B)
End Function
